note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Steps of browser/app screens are done by hand by the person recording.
prepare: $sqlPw = Read-Host 'SQL admin password (owner types, never stored)' -MaskInput
az group create -n rg-mglab-powerbi-10 -l westeurope --query name
az sql server create -n $srv -g rg-mglab-powerbi-10 -l westeurope --admin-user $login --admin-password $sqlPw --query name

az sql db create -n ContosoBikesIR -s $srv -g rg-mglab-powerbi-10 --edition GeneralPurpose --family Gen5 --capacity 2 --compute-model Serverless --use-free-limit true --free-limit-exhaustion-behavior AutoPause --query useFreeLimit
az sql server firewall-rule create -g rg-mglab-powerbi-10 -s $srv -n laptop --start-ip-address $myIp --end-ip-address $myIp --query name
az sql server firewall-rule create -g rg-mglab-powerbi-10 -s $srv -n azure-services --start-ip-address 0.0.0.0 --end-ip-address 0.0.0.0 --query name

screens.name: desktop-filter
steps: Open C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep10\src\ContosoSalesIR.pbip; Transform data > Edit parameters > SqlServer = the server name; sign in with the SQL login; Refresh
Query list: SqlServer, SqlDatabase, RangeStart, RangeEnd and the Sales query with the filter step
Right-click the InPeriod step > View Native Query: enabled, SQL with both dates in the WHERE (if greyed out say so)
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)

screens.name: policy-dialog
steps: Sales table context menu > Incremental refresh
Switch on: archive 3 years, refresh 10 days, detect data changes on Modified Date; Only refresh complete days as wanted (note what it does to the TMDL policy)
Leave Get the latest data in real time off and say why (needs Premium); then Home > Publish > Contoso Sales (Lab) once (never again)

screens.name: ssms-partitions
steps: Workspace settings: copy the workspace connection string (XMLA read-write enabled by the capacity admin)
SSMS Connect > Analysis Services, server = that string, sign in as alex.demo
Databases > ContosoSalesIR > Tables > Sales > Partitions: expect 28 partitions on 2026-11-21 (18 historical, 10 refresh)
Compare with python tools\ir_partitions.py --model ..\src\ContosoSalesIR.SemanticModel\definition --date <recording day>; write down the real partition names (month numbering)
mask: workspace connection string and tenant name
account e-mail in the connect dialog

screens.name: after-changes
steps: Terminal: run sql\02-late-changes.sql on the database (sqlcmd as in prepare, password typed off camera)
Service: refresh the model; report shows the recent-days correction, Sales Amount card first state

Terminal at C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep10\src: .\pipeline\Invoke-PartitionRefresh.ps1 -WorkspaceId $ws -SemanticModelId $ds -Table Sales -Partition <March 2023 partition name from SSMS> -SkipRefreshPolicy (rehearse with -WhatIf first)
Show the Sales Amount card again: record both states
mask: workspace and model ids in the URL

teardown: # owner signs in to Azure again if the session expired
# owner: delete the published model ContosoSalesIR and its report in the workspace
owner_notes: Azure SQL free tier (cost 0, AutoPause at the monthly limit). Capacity XMLA read-write and the tenant setting for XMLA endpoints must be enabled by labadmin. Close SSMS/sqlcmd sessions afterwards so the database can pause.
